name: Onna Kyoushi Nijuusan-sai
source:
English teacher is attacked by a molester on the way home from work. She cries for help, but molester has a menacing look and turns out to be from a powerful family, so no one dares to interfere. But that is only an overture to the tragedy ...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名英语教师下班回家途中遭到色狼袭击。她呼救，却因对方神色凶恶、又出身权势家庭，无人敢插手。但这不过是悲剧的序幕……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
